name: Adidas

name: BMW
notes: Report is split into chapter PDFs; this is the 'Group Financial Statements' chapter (balance sheet, income statement, notes). No ESEF link on the downloads page.

name: Fresenius Medical Care
notes: Annual Report 2025 ('The power of care') was published 2026-03-12 per the company's press release. freseniusmedicalcare.com refused or reset every connection from this environment (curl, headless browser and WebFetch), so no PDF link could be confirmed. Do not confuse with Fresenius SE's report on report.fresenius.com (different company). FMC also files a Form 20-F with the SEC, which could serve as a fallback source.

name: ABB Ltd
notes: US GAAP. The 'Financial Report 2025' holds the consolidated financial statements (the Integrated Report is a separate PDF). abb.com timed out or returned HTTP/2 errors to WebFetch and headless Chromium, so this link was NOT confirmed on the IR page. It was found by web search on ABB's official document library (library.e.abb.com) and returns application/pdf. Two different library URLs exist for the Integrated Report; the Financial Report URL is unambiguous.

name: DSM-Firmenich AG

The PDF states that the ESEF version prevails in case of discrepancy. Separate consolidated statements and notes PDFs also exist. Do not confuse with the DSM B.V. report on dsm.com.

notes: Full 'Sika Business Year 2025' company report (Financial Report section with consolidated statements from about p.216). A standalone financial report PDF also exists (seen in search, not on the IR page).
